name: Exp_iRSISign
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iRSISign indicator, which generates buy and sell signals when RSI crosses user-defined overbought and oversold levels. It opens and closes positions according to these RSI crossover signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义iRSISign指标的信号进行交易，当RSI穿越用户设定的超买和超卖水平时生成买卖信号。它根据这些RSI交叉信号开仓和平仓，并配有可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI动量指标的自定义变体iRSISign，该指标在RSI突破超买水平（默认70）时产生买入信号，在跌破超卖水平（默认30）时产生卖出信号。入场条件为：当指标的上行信号缓冲区出现有效值（非零且非空值）时开多单，当下行信号缓冲区出现有效值时开空单。出场条件包括：RSI超买信号触发多单平仓，超卖信号触发空单平仓，同时设置了固定点数的止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的五种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、按余额比例、按可用保证金比例等。策略还包含一个回溯检查机制，当同时允许开仓和平仓且当前无平仓信号时，会向前回溯历史K线寻找是否有尚未触发的反向平仓信号，以避免遗漏平仓机会。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a custom RSI momentum indicator variant called iRSISign, which generates buy signals when RSI breaks above the overbought level (default 70) and sell signals when it drops below the oversold level (default 30). Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the indicator's upper signal buffer produces a valid value (non-zero and non-empty), and a short position is opened when the lower signal buffer produces a valid value. Exit conditions include: RSI overbought signal triggers long position closure, oversold signal triggers short position closure, with fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points). Position sizing leverages five money management modes from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, including fixed lot, balance-proportional, and free margin-proportional modes. The strategy also incorporates a retrospective check mechanism: when both opening and closing are enabled but no close signal exists on the current bar, it loops back through historical bars to find any untriggered reverse close signal, preventing missed exit opportunities.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，根据模式表示手数或比例

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：固定手数/按余额/按可用保证金等
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/net margin/net balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（平空单）
parameters.description_en: Allow buy-side close (close sell on opposite signal)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（平多单）
parameters.description_en: Allow sell-side close (close buy on opposite signal)

pros: 信号逻辑清晰，基于经典RSI超买超卖交叉，易于理解和验证
提供五种资金管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
买卖开平仓可独立控制，便于部分策略测试和优化
使用IsNewBar机制避免同一K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
具有回溯检查机制，防止遗漏反向平仓信号
pros_en: Clear signal logic based on classic RSI overbought/oversold crossovers, easy to understand and verify
Five money management modes provide high flexibility to suit different risk preferences
Buy/sell open and close can be independently controlled, facilitating partial strategy testing and optimization
IsNewBar mechanism prevents repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Retrospective check mechanism prevents missing reverse close signals
cons: ATR_Period变量未声明为input，用户无法在策略测试器中直接优化该参数
固定止损止盈不考虑市场波动性（如ATR），在不同行情下可能不适
缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下短线信号可能导致亏损
回溯检查循环可能遍历大量历史K线，存在性能隐患
依赖外部自定义指标iRSISign和TradeAlgorithms库，移植性较差
cons_en: ATR_Period variable is not declared as input, preventing direct optimization in the strategy tester
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility (e.g., ATR), potentially unsuitable across varying market conditions
No spread filter, which may cause losses on short-term signals in high-spread environments
The retrospective check loop may iterate through a large number of historical bars, posing performance concerns
Depends on external custom indicator iRSISign and TradeAlgorithms library, reducing portability
improvements: 将ATR_Period声明为input参数，使其可在策略测试器中优化，并考虑基于ATR动态调整止损止盈
添加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
为回溯检查循环添加最大迭代次数限制，防止性能问题
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
improvements_en: Declare ATR_Period as an input parameter for optimization, and consider ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high-spread and low-liquidity periods
Add a maximum iteration limit to the retrospective check loop to prevent performance issues
Add position check logic to avoid duplicate opening when an existing same-direction position is already held

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未根据市场波动性动态调整，在极端行情下可能造成较大亏损
缺乏点差过滤，在高点差品种上交易成本可能吞噬利润
没有持仓检查，可能在同一方向重复开仓导致过度敞口
回溯检查无迭代上限，极端情况下可能影响EA响应速度
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit not dynamically adjusted for market volatility, may cause large losses in extreme conditions
No spread filter, trading costs on high-spread instruments may erode profits
No position check, may open duplicate same-direction positions leading to excessive exposure
Retrospective check has no iteration limit, potentially affecting EA responsiveness in extreme cases

summary_en: This EA trades based on signals from the custom iRSISign indicator, which generates buy and sell signals when RSI crosses user-defined overbought and oversold levels. It opens and closes positions according to these RSI crossover signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
